flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/{index.tsx, lists/ReportList.tsx (Workorder Reports tab commented out), lists/ReportListWorkOrder.tsx, lists/ReportListDOS.tsx}, utils/models/Fapi.d.ts (reports/workorder/excel comment); ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/datahiveuenfin/{services/DataHiveUenFinService, models/DataHiveFinData}, schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, cron-schedules-prod.properties; ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/plusintegration/controllers/PlusIntegrationController (inbound PLUS only). No work order/tagging code in ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi
note: Story status is blank, traced normally; there is no OCMS flow deck. The story asks the officer to pick one address per ID from the flagged list so that a work order holds only 1 address per ID. There is no code: no address selection screen, no storage of the choice, and no work order is formed (no work order endpoint/component; the work order Excel is only a type comment in Fapi.d.ts:307). Manual address editing per notice in the staff portal (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Notice/mode/edit/EditForm.tsx) is a generic per-notice feature, not per-ID address selection for a work order. It depends on OCMS34.7-34.9, which are not built.
recommendation: Do not claim. There is no per-ID address selection and no work order; per-notice address editing in the staff portal is generic.

steps.step: Officer selects one address for each flagged ID
steps.detail: There is no per-ID address selection screen. The Workorder Reports grid is commented out (ReportList.tsx:147-201) and only holds notice/vehicle/ref columns, with no address choice (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:55-70).

steps.step: The chosen address is saved and added to the work order
steps.detail: Nothing stores the address choice and no work order is formed: there is no work order controller/service in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi, and `reports/workorder/excel` is only a type comment (Fapi.d.ts:307).

steps.step: The work order shows only one address per ID
steps.detail: There is no rule or validation of 1 address per ID for a work order because the work order itself does not exist (see OCMS34.13 for work order Excel generation).
